note: text = caption wording; say = what the TTS reads when pronunciation needs help. gapBefore = silence before a scene's first line; holdAfter = extra time after a line for the on-screen action to finish. Figures (120 students, 48 fully cleared) are the demo school's data as the app reports it.

lines.text: It's clearance week.
Every final-year student needs a signature from every office before they collect their certificate.
Library. Labs. Dining hall. Housemaster.
Long queues, lost forms, and nobody knows who still owes what.
CAS moves the whole clearance online.
Set up your offices once: the library, labs, stores, heads of department and housemasters.
Add a new office, like the ICT lab.
Then assign the teacher who signs for it.
Non-teaching staff get their own staff accounts.
When your final-year students are ready, initiate a batch.
Pick their classes, and click Initiate.
120 students, each with their own checklist, matched to their programme and house.
lines.say: One hundred and twenty students, each with their own checklist, matched to their programme and house.

lines.text: Each office sees only the students waiting on it.
Look up a student by ID,
and clear them in one tap.
Still owing?
Mark them not cleared, and record exactly why.
Non-teaching staff do the same from the staff portal.
Students follow their own clearance from their phone.
They see which offices have cleared them, and what is still outstanding.
Unpaid fees appear automatically from the accounts records.
In the admin portal, every student's progress is live.
Filter by class or status, and open any student to see each office.
Need to step in? Override any office, with a note.
Your head of school sees the totals at a glance.
And before a certificate goes out, one check shows whether the student is fully cleared.
CAS. Comprehensive Academic Suite.
Clearance without the queues.
Call LatexTech on 024 8234 649 for a free walkthrough.
